toolboxes.name: UniHarmony
toolboxes.description: A unified Python package bundling ComBat and several of its extensions alongside interpolation- and optimal-transport-based harmonization methods behind one consistent interface.

toolboxes.name: ComBatFamily (R)
toolboxes.description: R package unifying ComBat and its extensions under one modeling framework and a consistent API: ComBat (Johnson et al., 2007), ComBat-GAM (Pomponio et al., 2020), Longitudinal ComBat (Beer et al., 2020), Robust ComBat (work-in-progress), ComBatLS (Gardner et al., preprint), and ComBat-Predict for new, unseen sites (Xin et al., 2026).

toolboxes.name: Intensity Normalization
toolboxes.description: General-purpose Python toolbox for MR image intensity normalization, splitting methods into two kinds: individual methods (Z-score, FCM, KDE, WhiteStripe — plain functions of one image, no fitting step) and population methods (Nyúl–Udupa, LSQ, RAVEL — learn a transform from a set of images, save it, then apply it to new scans). Also bundles supporting tools not modeled as separate entries here: tissue membership maps, histogram plotting for validation, N4 bias-field preprocessing, and ANTs-based co-registration. This is why several of those methods' pages link to the same repo: it's the same shared implementation, not a data error.

toolboxes.name: NeuroHarm-kit
toolboxes.description: Dockerized, open-source framework that unifies end-to-end execution of five deep-learning harmonization methods behind one CLI, bundling pretrained weights for all of them so nothing needs to be trained or fine-tuned from scratch.

toolboxes.name: DPABI Harmonization
toolboxes.description: Harmonization module of the DPABI MATLAB toolbox, with a graphical interface so multi-site resting-state fMRI and structural data can be harmonized without programming. Bundles ComBat-family and other site-correction methods (including CovBat) next to DPABI's preprocessing and statistics.

toolboxes.name: ComBatFamQC
toolboxes.description: R package and Shiny app built on ComBatFamily: diagnose batch effects (visual and statistical checks), harmonize with ComBat, ComBat-GAM, Longitudinal ComBat or CovBat, and run post-harmonization analyses such as lifespan age trends. Useful for the before/after checks in the Guide tab.

toolboxes.name: pyRiemann
toolboxes.description: scikit-learn-compatible library for machine learning on covariance matrices (EEG, MEG, BCI). Its transfer-learning module provides re-centering, stretching and rotation of covariance distributions across domains (the Riemannian Procrustes operations), the building blocks of covariance-based M/EEG harmonization.
